name: english-coach
description: AI Communication Coach - an AI speaking coach for Ethiopian students and professionals

comments.python: The server is FastAPI. These scripts assume server/.venv exists and use the Windows path; on macOS or Linux replace .venv/Scripts with .venv/bin.
comments.database: Postgres runs locally by default. docker compose is kept as a fallback via db:docker:up.

scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "pnpm start:server" "pnpm --filter client start"
scripts.db:reset: cd server && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m alembic downgrade base && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m alembic upgrade head && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m app.seed.run
